limitation: Partial fornix includes bilateral source-traced postcommissural descent. Full fimbria and precise mammillary terminal boundaries remain incomplete. Approximate boundaries; not expert-reviewed.

primaryReview.rationale: Li2026 Figure2A and UTHealth Figure1 B/C distinguish postcommissural fornix from mammillothalamic fibers. Wider native40 source views show bilateral oblique bands below the anterior commissure. Nine native draft planes and six final grid-footprint planes were reviewed. Of979 candidates,939 unlabeled cells were adopted and nine legacy33 plus31 mammillary40 cells were preserved. Both existing side components extend inferiorly. Partial-volume borders are approximate; adjacency is not proof of axonal continuity.
